content_zh:
【楼主消消气，他也不是第一次坑爹……我想知道然后发生什么了？——回复人：八连杀食神】
【神龙说：“哦，好的。”……之后就消失了！只留下了三张挂在庙里用的心愿卡！——楼主回复。】
这个故事告诉我们，做人不能太异想天开……
现在钟离秋就觉得关立远的话太“异想天开”了！
一次模拟试炼都没有进行过，体能更只是普通人中的普通人的关立远，能够“开灵”成功？
但是因为不忍心不戳破关立远最后一线希望，钟离秋并没有说其他的，只是点头道：“可以！”
时光荏苒，转眼间，三个月过去了。
这三个月中，关立远作为校霸钟离秋的“两员大将”之一，过得很舒服。
嗯，钟离秋“手下”也只有两个人，一个抱大腿性质的关立远，另一各则是从小和她一起长大的闺蜜魏樱樱，魏樱樱一家也都算是钟离家族的附属成员……
至于其他人，对于脾气“耿直”，或者说是刁蛮、任性、主观……的钟离秋，一向都是尊敬、但敬而远之！
普通朋友虽然有一些，但是却没到会在一起厮混的程度。
而这三个月里，最令关立远开心的是，就在半个月前，自己又把贡文坑了一次！
每天孜孜不倦的给自己做“生命倒计时”的贡文，不知为何“看破了”关立远的“色厉内荏”、心中的“惴惴不安”，大发慈悲的给了他一个戴罪立功的机会……
那就是希望伙同关立远，给钟离秋设下了圈套，到时候不但能让她吃个大亏，而且还会名节受损！
虽然因为钟离家族的势力与作风，贡文不敢真的下什么不可描述的药，但是让她丢个大人还是敢的。
然而在他看来，已经只剩下半个月的“存活时间”，心里肯定已经紧张的不得了的关立远，却一转手就把他卖了，和钟离秋一起将计就计，将贡文又臭揍一顿，而且还揭发了他的阴谋，令许多学员背地里对其不耻，贡氏家族内部也对贡文有些不满了……
当然，贡文现在对关立远“欲生啖其肉”的仇视，自然也不用多提。
“立远，马上就是开灵仪式了……”
在开灵会场中，钟离秋神情沮丧的对关立远说着什么……
“秋！”魏樱樱似乎是担心关立远的心情，小声提醒钟离秋别说这些。

本来从五年前“半觉醒”之后，就一直对“开灵”期待不已的钟离秋，因为关立远的事情，现在对开灵仪式异常的抗拒！
自从半个月前，又揍了贡文一顿之后，一向元气满满的钟离秋，就一直情绪低落……
忽然想起了什么，钟离秋对关立远怒道：“之前就不应该听你这个蠢货的！像樱樱一开始计划的那样，让贡文稍微得意一下又怎么了？我只要注意注意，不吃大亏就可以……到时候只要……以后自然有机会，将你从贡氏家族救出来的！”
没错，半个月前魏樱樱和钟离秋其实想过，顺势让贡文得意一下，令关立远稍微在贡氏家族好过些的，但是关立远自己却反而一力主张……揍他丫的！
“哈哈哈，这不是‘我贡氏家族资助下完成了学业’的关立远同学吗？马上就要‘开灵’了，‘万一’你开灵失败的话，别忘了……就到了‘报答’我们贡氏家族的时候了！”
就在这时，贡文意气风发的走过来说道。
一开始的时候，还尽可能的表现的淡然，毕竟“开灵仪式”是由杜兰城的联盟组织的，杜兰三院的“开灵仪式”排在了今天，现在联盟在杜兰城的不少重要人物都在场，他也要注意影响，但是说到最后的时候，脸上已经满是狰狞……
同时在说完的时候，也已经走近到了关立远面前，小声对他说道：“小杂种！是时候让你知道，杂种和‘人’的区别了！你以为有这头小母老虎保护你，就能够安然无恙？杂种就是杂种，等着吧……我会把你的骨头一根根捏断！”
贡文自然不会想到，一开始就是贡氏家族先坑了关立远，看到流落街头的他之后，马上强制其卖身，而且还串通辛主任，做了假档案……而是一心认为，关立远十恶不赦的反抗了他。

[The poster calm down, this is not the first time he has cheated on me... I want to know what happened next? ——Replyer: Eight consecutive kills of the God of Cookery]
[Shenlong said: "Oh, okay."...and then disappeared! Only three wish cards were left for hanging in the temple! ——The original poster replied. 】
This story tells us that we should not be too whimsical...
Now Zhong Liqiu feels that Guan Liyuan's words are too "whimsical"!
Can Guan Liyuan, who has never conducted a single simulation trial and whose physical fitness is only that of an ordinary person among ordinary people, be able to successfully "open his spirit"?
But because he couldn't bear to expose Guan Liyuan's last glimmer of hope, Zhong Liqiu didn't say anything else. He just nodded and said, "Okay!"
Time flies, and in the blink of an eye, three months have passed.
During these three months, Guan Liyuan lived very comfortably as one of the "two generals" of school bully Zhong Liqiu.
Well, there are only two "underlings" of Zhongli Qiu. One is Guan Liyuan, who has a hugging nature, and the other is her best friend Wei Yingying who grew up with her. Wei Yingying and her family are also considered affiliated members of the Zhongli family...
As for other people, they have always respected Zhong Liqiu, but kept a distance from him, who has an "upright" temper, or can be said to be unruly, willful, and subjective...
Although they have some ordinary friends, they are not enough to hang out together.
In the past three months, what made Guan Liyuan happiest was that just half a month ago, he had tricked Gongwen again!
He worked tirelessly to give himself a "countdown to life" tribute every day, and somehow "saw through" Guan Liyuan's "serious appearance" and "uneasiness" in his heart, and mercifully gave him a chance to redeem himself and make meritorious deeds...
That is, he hopes to work with Guan Liyuan to set a trap for Zhong Liqiu. Not only will she suffer a big loss, but her reputation will also be damaged!
Although Gongwen didn't dare to give any unspeakable medicine because of the Zhongli family's power and style, he still dared to make her look like an adult.
However, in his opinion, there was only half a month of "survival time" left, and Guan Liyuan, who must have been extremely nervous, sold him out as soon as he changed hands, and together with Zhong Liqiu, they used the trick to beat Gongwen again. They also exposed his conspiracy, which made many students feel ashamed of him secretly, and the Gong family was also somewhat dissatisfied with Gongwen...
Of course, there is no need to mention Gongwen's current hatred towards Guan Liyuan for "eating his flesh".
"Liyuan, the spiritual opening ceremony is about to begin..."
In the spiritual ceremony venue, Zhong Liqiu said something to Guan Liyuan with a depressed expression...
"Qiu!" Wei Yingying seemed to be worried about Guan Liyuan's mood, and whispered to Zhong Liqiu not to say such things.
Zhong Liqiu, who had been looking forward to the "spiritual opening" since her "semi-awakening" five years ago, is now extremely resistant to the spiritual opening ceremony because of Guan Liyuan's incident!
Ever since he beat Gong Wen again half a month ago, Zhong Liqiu, who was always full of energy, has been in a low mood...
Suddenly remembering something, Zhong Liqiu said angrily to Guan Liyuan: "I shouldn't have listened to you idiot before! What's the matter with letting Gongwen feel a little proud like Yingying planned at the beginning? I just need to be careful and don't suffer a big loss... then as long as... I will naturally have the opportunity to rescue you from the Gong family!"
That's right, Wei Yingying and Zhong Liqiu actually thought about it half a month ago to make Gong Wen proud and make Guan Liyuan feel a little better in the Gong family. However, Guan Liyuan himself strongly advocated...beat him!
"Hahaha, isn't this classmate Guan Liyuan who 'finished his studies with the support of my Gong family'? He will be 'opened' soon. 'In case' you fail to open your spirit, don't forget... it's time to 'repay' our Gong family!"
At this moment, Gongwen came over in high spirits and said.
At the beginning, I tried my best toHe was indifferent. After all, the "spiritual opening ceremony" was organized by the alliance in Duran City. The "spiritual opening ceremony" of the Third Academy of Tulan was scheduled for today. Now many important figures from the alliance in Dulan City were present. He also had to pay attention to the impact, but when he said it at the end, his face was full of ferocity...
At the same time, when he finished speaking, he had already approached Guan Liyuan and whispered to him: "Little bastard! It's time for you to know the difference between bastards and 'humans'! Do you think that with this little tigress protecting you, you will be safe and sound? Bastards are bastards, just wait...I will break your bones one by one!"
Naturally, Gong Wen would not have thought that it was the Gong family who had tricked Guan Liyuan in the first place. After seeing him living on the street, they immediately forced him to sell himself. They also colluded with Director Xin to create a false file... Instead, he thought that Guan Liyuan resisted him in a heinous manner.
